falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that bottom held at 4,811; this would signal structural weakness inconsistent with a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 28; sustained readings above 35 would indicate panic-level dislocation, proving the current 40 blowoff score understated true stress and the pattern match failed

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield > 2Y yield by >10bps) and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Curve uninversion during risk-off typically signals recession conviction; August 2024 bottom occurred with curve deeply inverted, so this would contradict the pattern's macro setup and invalidate the bottom call

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
